n=ratio(rgb(cs.color),bg);min=Math.min(min,n);count++;if(n<4.5)failures.push({text:e.textContent.slice(0,70),ratio:n});}if(visualViewport.scale!==1||devicePixelRatio!==1||getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).zoom!==\'1\'||!count||min<4.5||document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth||document.getAnimations().some(a=>a.playState===\'running\'))throw button\').getBoundingClientRect().height,columnWidth:document.querySelector(\'.unfool-column\').getBoundingClientRect().width,bodyFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfoolable\')).fontSize,titleFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfool-task h2\')).fontSize,statusFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfool-status\')).fontSize,cards:window.__finishCards,visibleTicketRows:document.querySelectorAll(\'.unfool-task\').length,marks:[...document.querySelectorAll(\'.hallmark-well\')].map(x=>x.getAttribute(\'aria-label\'))};}');
